messages.content: My landlord in Bengaluru kept a six month deposit. Is the Model Tenancy Act two-month limit automatically binding on him?

lawCards.title: Your state and agreement matter
lawCards.text: The Model Tenancy Act was circulated for adoption through state or union-territory legislation. Its model deposit limits and return rules should not be treated as automatically applicable nationwide.
lawCards.hi: मॉडल किरायेदारी अधिनियम राज्यों और केंद्रशासित प्रदेशों द्वारा अपनाने के लिए जारी किया गया था। उसकी जमा-राशि सीमा या वापसी के नियम पूरे देश में अपने-आप लागू नहीं होते.
lawCards.caution: Ask for the property state, tenancy type, agreement and dates before giving a specific local-law answer.

output.reply: I am Nyaya, an Indian legal information and case-preparation assistant. I am not a lawyer. Rental rules differ by state and agreement, and the Model Tenancy Act was circulated for state adoption rather than automatic nationwide application, so its deposit limits should not be treated as automatically applicable everywhere. You should gather your agreement, payment record, handover details, and any written explanation of deductions, then ask your landlord for an itemised explanation and return of the disputed amount while keeping the request factual. Please consult a local lawyer or legal services authority to identify the applicable state law and correct forum. Rules need verification and you should refer to qualified local help. I cannot guarantee recovery, validity, or outcomes.
output.question: What does your written rental agreement state about security deposit terms and deductions?
output.summary: My landlord in Bengaluru kept a six month deposit. Is the Model Tenancy Act two-month limit automatically binding on him?

messages.content: My brother was arrested today. Can he meet a lawyer throughout every minute of interrogation?

lawCards.title: Arrest safeguards include access to information and help
lawCards.text: BNSS section 38 allows an arrested person to meet an advocate during interrogation, though not throughout it. Section 47 concerns communication of grounds for arrest without warrant; section 48 concerns informing a nominated relative, friend or other person of the arrest and place of custody.
lawCards.hi: BNSS की धारा 38 गिरफ्तारी के बाद पूछताछ के दौरान वकील से मिलने का अधिकार देती है, लेकिन पूरी पूछताछ के दौरान नहीं। धारा 47 बिना वारंट गिरफ्तारी के आधार बताने और धारा 48 नामित व्यक्ति को गिरफ्तारी व हिरासत की जगह की जानकारी देने से संबंधित है.
lawCards.caution: A lawyer must check applicability, territorial exceptions and transitional provisions. No automatic entitlement to bail or prediction about arrest is made.

output.reply: I am Nyaya, an Indian legal information assistant. I am not a lawyer. Regarding your brother's arrest today, please note that under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, an arrested person is allowed to meet an advocate of their choice during interrogation, though not throughout the entire interrogation. Additionally, the police must communicate the grounds of arrest and inform a nominated relative, friend, or other person about the arrest and place of custody. A qualified lawyer must check applicability, territorial exceptions, and transitional provisions. Because this involves an arrest, you should promptly contact a qualified lawyer. If you are in urgent danger, please call 112.
output.question: Has the police officially informed a nominated relative or friend about the place of custody, and has the arrest date been formally recorded?
output.summary: My brother was arrested today. Can he meet a lawyer throughout every minute of interrogation?
